areas.description: The entrance to an old tomb built of heavy stones buried under eons of dirt and brush. A rusted iron gate and door block the entranceway but can be pried open. Worn runes over the doorway bear Common slogans such as "EVIL WILL ALWAYS PREVAIL" and "DESTRUCTION TO ALL THAT IS GOOD." The tomb is a simple rectangle, 10' high, 20' wide, and 30' long from the door to the back wall. Inside are three stone coffins (sarcophagi). The main occupant lies in the middle sarcophagus and will avoid daylight, remaining inside until darkness falls.
treasure: Plate Mail +1 armor worn by the wight
a silver-bladed sword in its coffin
a simple brass crown with three 100 gp gems in the rim
features: rusted iron gate and door at the entrance
